Full upstream repository snapshot at pinned commit. Detection reads this checked-in
snapshot only; no network fetch occurs at runtime (§9). Machine-readable payload
files under every vulnerability folder are eligible for ingest. Files without a
real ReachAgent sink/oracle mapping remain reserved or skipped and are logged;
reserved payloads are never returned by get_payloads for firing.

The snapshot includes upstream documentation and supporting files because this is
a full clone, not the earlier curated five-folder slice. Raw payload values remain
behind source/relpath#Ln line locators in the tagged library.
